When I was at center (12, 21), all 3 red dots disappeared (they were on the diamond outline). But when I moved away, 2 of them reappeared. However, (9, 27) stayed collected because it was collected again during the movement path.

Hmm, but now at (18, 27), the red dots are back in their charcoal squares. So either:

2. The red dots were never collected, just temporarily hidden
Let me try a different approach. Instead of trying to collect the red dots with the red diamond, let me try collecting the orange dots with the orange X. Maybe the level completes when all dots of all colors are collected, and I need to use each tool for its matching color.
